title: Federal Reserve System Established
description: US Congress passes the Federal Reserve Act, establishing the central bank of the United States to manage monetary policy and lender-of-last-resort functions.

title: Plaza Accord Currency Agreement
description: France, West Germany, Japan, UK, and US agree to depreciate the US dollar relative to the Japanese yen and German mark, accelerating Japanese domestic asset inflation.

title: Launch of the Euro
description: The Euro is introduced as an accounting currency in 11 European member states, creating the world's second-largest monetary union.

title: Quantitative Easing (QE) Launch
description: Federal Reserve initiates large-scale asset purchases (QE1), buying Treasury bonds and agency mortgage-backed securities to lower long-term interest rates.

title: Global Anti-Inflation Hiking Cycle
description: Federal Reserve, ECB, and global central banks execute the fastest interest rate hiking cycle in 40 years to combat post-COVID inflation.
